displayName: GHADV-2045: CedarJava has policy injection vulnerability
description:
CedarJava has policy injection vulnerability

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_code_injection_ghadv_2045", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%cedarjava%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%policy%') AND "value" > 0
